Zombie''' is a [[spell]] that consumes a [[corpse]] to summon an allied zombie [[minion]]. Zombies are permanent minions with no duration that follow the user that summoned them. ==Skill functions and interactions== * '''Support Gems''': Raise Zombie can be supported by [[minion]] supports and any supports valid for the skill they use, a [[Melee]] [[Strike]] [[Attack]]. ** Raise Zombie can be modified as a [[Spell]] (e.g. cast time, [[trigger]]ing), but minions it summons do not count as spell effects. Increasing spell damage does not affect the damage of zombies. * '''Corpse Targeting''': Holding down the corpse targeting toggle (defaults to the {{key press|A}} button) makes it easier to choose a corpse to raise. * '''Zombie Limit''': The maximum amount of raised zombies can be increased by passive skills and unique items (see below for more information). * {{c|mod|Minions have #% more Maximum Life}} is a local mod, which only applies to Zombies raised by this copy of skill; it does not affect other minions or zombies raised by other skills, or zombies raised from another copy of Raise Zombie (or {{il|Raise Zombie of Slamming}}). ==Gem level progression== {{Skill progression |c1_abbr = Maximum

|group=1 |domain=1 }} {{Skill enchantment modifier list|query=mods.generation_type=10 AND mods.stat_text_raw LIKE "%Zombie%"}} ==Zombie limit== By default, the player can summon up to six zombies at a given time with a level 20 gem. This limit can be increased with certain passive skills or items. ===Passive skills=== The following [[passive skills]] increase the player's zombie limit: {{Query base passive skills |where=passive_skill_stats.id LIKE "%zombie%" }} ===Unique items=== The following [[unique items]] affect the player's zombie limit: {{Drop enabled unique item table |tables=item_stats |join=items._pageID=item_stats._pageID |where=item_stats.id LIKE "%number_of_zombies_allowed%" OR items.name="Eyes of the Greatwolf" |large=1 |base_item=1 |level=1 |stat=1 }} ===Mods=== Amulets can have an influence mod {{ml|MaximumZombiesUber1}} to have {{c|mod|+1 to maximum number of Raised Zombies}}. Alternatively, similar mod {{ml|MaximumMinionCountAmuletZombieDelve}} can be found on non-influenced amulets that drop in specific [[Delve]] nodes. Lastly, {{il|Spider Crab Talisman }} has the enchantment {{c|enchanted|+15% to Quality of all Skill Gems}} (indirectly increase the limit through gem quality). It is possible to create a talisman with both the implicit and influence explicit, by using the craft from [[Craicic Squid]] (which rotates the base). Or crafting the influence explicit directly on the Spider Crab Talisman base. Other base and unique that are useful are {{il|Croaker Talisman}} ({{c|enchanted|+1 to Level of all Skill Gems}} to combine with other gem level mod) or {{il|Ashes of the Stars}} (increase gem level and gem quality item mods). The Delve mod {{ml|MaximumMinionCountZombieDelve}} can also be found on certain body armour drops in Delve. There are other mods ({{ml|JunMasterMaximumZombieAndSkeleton1}} or {{ml|JunMaster2MaximumZombieAndSkeleton1_}}) on legacy body armour, but they can only be obtained from trading with other players in the permanent leagues. They are in the same mod group "MaximumMinionCount" so +2 body armour is not possible. [[Jun, Veiled Master]] can unveil a [[veiled mod]] mod for [[helmets]]: {{ml|JunMasterVeiledMaximumZombieAndSkeleton|display=verbose}}; the crafted mod equivalent is {{ml|JunMaster2MaximumZombieAndSkeleton1_|display=verbose}} Every 20% gem quality adds +1 to zombie limit. Examples of other quality improving items:{{il|Dialla's Malefaction}}, a weapon with [[Haku, Warmaster#Signature mods|Haku's signature mod]]. By [[Scourge|scourging]] a pair of rare boots (or unique boots if [[Blood Crucible]] skill is allocated), there is a chance to acquire {{ml|HellscapeUpsideAdditionalRaisedZombie1_}} Scourge mod. The [[scourge]] mechanic is not yet added to the core game so these mods are only available in permanent leagues. ===Total=== Players can have a maximum of 19 (20 if using talisman, 21 or more with legacy items/gem quality or Baron stacking) zombies at once: *6 from the level 20 skill gem (up to 8 zombies from level 34 gems, but not practical to reach such gem level) * 1 from 20% gem quality * +0.5 from Raise Zombie is socketed in matching color socket (requires to combine with other gem quality methods) *2 from passive skills *1 from a body armour (Delve mod/legacy mod or {{il|Dialla's Malefaction}} gem quality) *1 from Jun's veiled mod/crafted mod on helmet *1 from amulet (elder or Delve explicits, or any roll {{il|Ashes of the Stars}}) ** +1.5 can be achieved to combine the effect from explicit mod and {{il|Spider Crab Talisman}} ({{c|enchanted|+15% to Quality of all Skill Gems}}), or a max roll {{il|Ashes of the Stars}} (+30% gem quality) * +0.5 from weapon with Haku's unveiled increase gem quality mod, can only be used when the Raise Zombie gem is socketed in that weapon (so that having the 0.5+0.5 limit from +10% from Haku mod, and another +10% gem quality from socket color. ie. Gem cannot be socketed in {{il|Dialla's Malefaction}} and effects from {{il|Spider Crab Talisman}} (15% gem quality) and {{il|Ashes of the Stars}} (20-30% gem quality) are not take into account, or having other source of gem quality to reach the 20/40/60/80% gem quality break-points ) * +1 from +24% quality from level 4 {{il|Awakened Enhance Support}} ;7 from unique items: *2 from dual wielding {{il|Midnight Bargain}} (not if using Haku's mod) *5 from {{il|The Baron}} with 2500 Strength (1 zombie per 500 Strength unless using legacy item; more may be viable) ---- * Legacy item only: boots with {{ml|HellscapeUpsideAdditionalRaisedZombie1_}} scourge modifier and with no other detrimental implicits that affect other sources of +1 limit. The [[scourge]] mechanic is not yet available in the core game after league end. ==Achievements== If you manage to raise the appropriate number of Zombies, you will be rewarded the following [[achievement]]: {| class="wikitable" style="text-align: center;" |- ! Name !! Description |- | Zombie Horde
